title: The hold, told by the conductor and the hold
moment: At 18:44 the conductor wrote the hold at the editor's word, giving as its reason, in the hold's own words, the editor's usage at 95 percent (C006). The work already in flight still landed: the designer's commit came 82 seconds later (C065).

panels.line: I could keep going. That is exactly why I am stopping.
Anyone can pull me. Only the editor puts me back.
I'm not the failure. I'm the brake that let everyone else go fast.
